# Pushed for review — Gerrit change 1639

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1639 — "Surface a failed tickets push to mute paths"
(10 files, +931/-89; `rebar-ticket: e1ed-b700-c442-4d0c`, DCO signed).

## Full-suite result

**11203 passed, 54 skipped** on a CLEAN run (no concurrent edits). Two pre-existing tests in
`tests/unit/test_mcp_writes.py` pinned `link_tickets` returning a bare `"ok"` string; they were
updated to read `out.result`, preserving their stated intent ("the substitution is stated in
full") while following the shape widening, and the no-escalation case now also asserts the
delivery field is present rather than silently omitted.

One earlier run showed a failure in `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py` that did NOT reproduce: it
passes 6/6 in isolation and did not recur on the clean run. It was self-inflicted — I was editing
files and running `git add -A` while that suite was in flight, which perturbs tests that shell out
and inspect repo state. The same artifact is recorded on 2a76. Not a defect in this change.

## Gates at push time

`make lint` (ruff + format + complexity baseline `new=0 increased=0` + zizmor + actionlint) green;
`make typecheck` green (503 files); MCP schema-drift gate green; output-schema coverage green;
`docs/mcp-reference.md` regenerated with no drift; every touched module under the 800-LOC cap.

Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`. Per AGENTS.md this ticket stays open until 1639 is
Verified and merged.
